questions.question: The LORD said His vineyard was destroyed and His plot of ground trampled. Who did He say had done it?
What did the LORD say He was about to do to the evil neighbors who attacked the inheritance of His people Israel?
After uprooting the evil neighbors of Israel, the LORD said He would never again show them compassion. True or false?
If Israel's evil neighbors diligently learned His people's ways and swore by His name, what did the LORD say would happen to them?

answers.text: They would be established among His people
They would be made rulers over His people
They would be kept as His people's servants
